chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Asbat, from al-Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about a man and a woman, when does the ritual bath become obligatory upon them? He said: When he enters (with her), the ritual bath, the dowry, and the stoning become obligatory.
ai.seo_question: When does the ritual bath and full dowry become obligatory in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the physical act of penetration, rather than mere proximity, is the decisive trigger for the full dowry (*mahr al-mithl*), the ritual bath (*ghusl*), and the penalty of stoning (*rجم*) in cases of adultery. This ruling underscores the jurisprudential principle that consummation establishes the complete marital bond's financial and ritual consequences, a key point of discussion among Shia jurists regarding the distinction between partial and full dowry.
